A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] Sullustan''' [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Detective/Legends|detective]] served in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], along with his [[Unidentified Mrlssi investigator|Mrlssi partner]], investigated the destruction of a [[Police cruiser backup unit|PCBU]] and the death of two [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. However, not knowing that a [[Darth Maul/Legends|Sith]] had committed the crime, they had no answer as to how someone had jumped 15 feet into the air to disable the PCBU without getting shot. Though [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] promised them the support of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he was called away to the help with the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade of Naboo]].
